description: The phone's Update bar at the foot of the home screen, under a rule from the chats, as Baude's sidebar has it, and the notifications that go with it. The phone is kept up to date from the Baude site's feed rather than git: looked at as the app starts, each time it is back in front (once a minute at most) and every hour in the background.
opens: shown at the home screen's foot whenever a newer build is found, ready, downloading or cannot be installed

parts.name: Update button
parts.shows: A text button "Update" at the foot. Shown while a newer build is ready, or found and waiting to be downloaded.

actions.does: installs the build over this one through Android's installer if it is ready; downloads it first if it is not, then installs. The first time, opens Android's page to allow installs from this app, and carries on as you come back. Android closes the app to replace it

parts.name: Daemon restart line
parts.shows: Over Update, one line per host keeping a daemon restart, as Baude's sidebar says This Mac's ("Restarting the daemon once N chats or tasks finish", or "Daemon restart paused"); tapped, the same "Waiting For" dialog with Restart and Force Restart.

decisions.said: When the daemon is waiting to restart, the owner wants to see which chats, tasks or services are holding it up; while that view is open the restart is paused, with Restart and Force Restart buttons (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app shows a host's pending daemon restart at the foot of its list; tapped or clicked, it lists what the restart waits for (each chat running a command, each task running) and the restart is paused while that view is open. Restart (or closing it) restarts once nothing is running; Force Restart restarts now. The host keeps the pending restart and its blockers and says them on the wire (info's restart), so every app shows the same

parts.name: Progress
parts.shows: A progress line over the button while the build downloads.

parts.name: Why line
parts.shows: For a newer build that cannot be installed over this one, the reason replaces the button, in dim text; that build is not downloaded again.

parts.name: Notifications
parts.shows: "A new version is ready" (silent, with an Update action; once per build, only if the app was not in front when it came); after an update, "<App> updated: N new commits" (from the difference in version codes), opened again from the notification; a toast "Baude closes to update: open it again once it has" when notifications are off; a toast "Couldn't update: <why>" when the installer fails. The notification channel is named Update.

parts.name: When it downloads
parts.shows: A newer build is downloaded by itself on a network that is not metered, checked (size, sha256, this app's package at the feed's version, signed as this one is) and only then offered. On a metered network it waits for Update, unless Settings → Update on metered connections is on.

states.name: found
states.shows: Update button; a metered network held the download

states.name: downloading
states.shows: Update button with progress along its top

states.name: ready
states.shows: Update button; the build is checked

states.name: wrong key
states.shows: The reason ("Can't update: the new version is signed with another key", or not this app, or cannot be read) instead of the button
